sourceFiles.pdf: SW Saga - Jedi Academy Training Manual (optimized).pdf

process.discoveryMethod: Independently searched the complete DJVU TXT (593,597 chars) for vehicle-type lines, statblock identity markers, transportation names, starfighters and references to ships. The uploaded primary PDF has 161 scanned physical pages with no selectable text layer. Rendered all 161 pages as eleven labeled 16-page contact sheets and visually checked book layout/statblock sections; rendered the original Chu'unthor statblock on printed p151 at 1.7x for direct primary-PDF type/identity/page confirmation. Preserved its existing Phase2B source review unchanged.
bookSectionsSwept: Chapter I: Power of the Force (Force Pilot and other vehicle-related powers)
Chapter III: Equipment & Artifacts (including beckon call and starship slave circuits)
Chapter IV: Affiliated Programs (including Aing-Tii living starships)
Chapter V: Instructors and Alumni (including Jedi pilots)
Chapter VI: Dangers of Study (NPC and creature statblocks)
Chapter VII: Studying Abroad (Chu'unthor, facilities, sites and other Jedi academies)
process.printedPdfMapping: Physical PDF p152 contains printed p151, with independent 'Chu'unthor CL 15' statblock.
process.visualReviewScope: Whole-book contact-sheet survey of all 161 physical pages, plus high-resolution render of printed p151; fully searchable DJVU text swept independently.
process.exhaustivenessCaveat: The source PDF contains only raster images; the DJVU text is an auxiliary discovery layer. Whole-book contact-sheet inspection supports no additional identifiable vehicle statblocks, but cannot absolutely exclude an image-obscured exceptional format.

identityDecisions.subject: Chu'unthor
identityDecisions.reason: Only independently printed CL 15 vehicle statblock in this book, already in the 318 approved spacecraft baseline and canonical ships; printed 'Colossal (station) capital ship' is a moving ship with starship-scale Speed, not an additional independent stationary installation claim.

identityDecisions.subject: Chu'unthor's various carried shuttlecraft
identityDecisions.reason: Its equipment lists 'Carried Craft various shuttlecraft'; the source does not provide separate identity/statblocks for those craft.

identityDecisions.subject: Aing-Tii living starships
identityDecisions.reason: Force tradition character-building description references flying aboard living ships but does not print a vehicle statblock.

identityDecisions.subject: Jedi starfighter missions and pilots
identityDecisions.reason: Individual Jedi backstories mention starfighters and pilot service without introducing a distinct vehicle statblock.

identityDecisions.subject: Force Pilot, Fold Space, and Spatial Integrity vehicle abilities
identityDecisions.reason: Force powers, techniques and talents referencing vehicles are character rules, not vehicle publication identities.

identityDecisions.subject: Beckon Call and starship slave circuits
identityDecisions.reason: Ship-remote accessory describes summoning an existing starship, not a separately printed ship or speeder model.

identityDecisions.subject: Holocron gatekeepers, Jedi instructors, Sith, creatures and monsters
identityDecisions.reason: Statblocks in these sections identify characters, gatekeepers or creatures rather than vehicles; no additional vehicle-type header identified.

identityDecisions.subject: Jedi temples, academies and places of study
identityDecisions.reason: Site/location descriptions are not independently printed vehicle statblocks; Chu'unthor itself is the single independently statted moving capital ship.
